message: What turnaround time should I expect?
Thanks for contacting me. Please send the images first; after I review them, I can give you the exact turnaround.
This is something I can do easily.
Will the process include opportunities for feedback and revisions?
You’ll receive it next Friday at 3 PM.
Yes ofcourse
One quick clarification: does the 85$ price apply to each illustration?
No, the budget covers all 8.
If it doesn’t work out, that’s okay.
Given how detailed these vector art drawings are, 400$ honestly feels quite low. Could we set the total at 900$?
If it’s possible for you, could you consider this request?
Along with the final source files, I’ll provide completely hand-drawn vector illustrations.
Thank you—I understand, and I wouldn’t want your labor to be underpaid.
No worries—we can proceed with 680\$.
Thanks! Please send me the contract offer.
The benefit to my profile health is why I want this project.
Underpaying you for this project is not something I want to do.
No need to worry; I agree to complete the work within this budget.
For this design, please use this type of bottle. Above it, place “Creativity grows around the Campfire” as cloud-shaped text like in the samples.

Everything else in this design looks good. Please use this referenced cartoon style to make it more cartoon-ish, and make “Creativity grows around the Campfire” on the meat appear stamped, like it does on the burger. Does that make sense?

Although the rest of the design looks good, it needs to feel more cartoon-ish. The grill contents are wrong—please use steak and onions. Keep “Creativity grows around the Campfire” looking like smoke, but make it a little easier to read.
I appreciate you taking this project on. One last note: I’d also be happy to add a bonus for your work.
Thanks for offering me the contract, Nolan. I’m starting work now and will update you in 3 days. I’d really appreciate the bonus as well. 😊
Absolutely, the bonus is approved!
If any project questions come up, please let me know.
Everything is clear for now, so I’m starting the work. I’ll share illustration seven with you in 6 hours.
For the final file, should I provide EPS (Adobe illustrator) or TIFF (photoshop/PSD)?
For “PNG JPG,” the final formats are SVG and PDF.
I’ve finished it and sent it over; please take a look. Thanks!
Although the work is off to a good start, I do have some feedback.
Please give this design the more cartoon-ish look shown in my included example.
Please add a text bubble to this design and make the font/text large enough to span the whole sky. Lastly, remove “Meadowbrook” and replace it with “Riverton.” Thanks!
The design is otherwise great. Please make the text easier to read and reshape the steaks so they resemble the included sample.
I’ll make those changes and return the revised work within 2 days.
Thank you!
The changes are now complete—please take a look. :)
Please use the font at <https://www.dafont.com/cloud-sketch.font?text=storytelling> for this design, and arrange the text across five straight lines.
The displayed slogan should read: “Creativity grows around the campfire”.
Storytelling is rendered as four words.
This one is complete :) For the PNG, please send two SVG versions: one with a green background and one without a green background. Thanks!!
We’re done with this one 🙂 For the PNG, please provide two SVG versions: one with a green background and another without a green background. Thanks!!
Understood, I'll handle it right now.
I’ll send you my feedback right away, since the last one is close to completion.
Sure

This is the version I prefer, but a few adjustments are still missing. Please make the tortillas resemble this reference more closely, keep the steak streaks from interfering with the text, and give the text a more stamp-like look.
Have I communicated my feedback in a way you can understand?
Got it!
If anything else is unclear, please send me your questions.
I’ve placed the svgs for all 8 designs in this tar archive instead of the zip of pngs. Please review them; once you approve them, I’ll share the final files.
The background is too dark behind this word; please clear or lighten it.
Please deliver this one as an SVG file rather than PNG: it should show only the strawberry with the bottle and grill. Thanks!
Sure
Nolan, with the changes complete, I’ve put all the final files in this tar archive rather than a zip file.
Ok
Where is the folder or file?
Kindly approve the milestone so I can go to sleep—lol—but only if everything is fine.
Got it—the only exception is the strawberry on its own; everything else looks good.
strawberry alone?
Do you see it too? Both the bottle and the smoke look cut off.
Should I leave both the bottle and the smoke out, then?
They should both stay; the problem is that they look cut off.
I'll take a look.
On my side, I’m not seeing the cutoff; it looks fine.
It's SVG, causing that appearance; clipping observations conflict, while PNG is also reported.
I’ll take care of the fix, okay.
Thanks! Could you also remove the "pineapple" text you see on the bottle?
That's it :)
Sure
Please take a look now; I’ve completed the changes.
Just this
Please take a look now; I’ve fixed the remaining issue.
